summary: The plan must be regenerated to add pointer-event resizing, dynamic maximum dimensions and clamping, and drag-safe accessible header controls.

requiredChanges.title: Use Pointer Events for docked resizing
requiredChanges.description: Replace mouse-only document listeners with pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel. Ensure listeners are cleaned up when resizing ends and on component unmount.

requiredChanges.title: Add dynamic maximum dimensions and clamp restored layout
requiredChanges.description: Define maximum width and height constraints for floating and docked modes, preserve a usable minimum width for the main content, and clamp width, height, x and y on restoration and viewport resize.

requiredChanges.title: Prevent controls from initiating drag and add accessible labels
requiredChanges.description: Use a dedicated drag handle or a react-rnd cancel selector for buttons and other controls. Add explicit aria-label values to float, dock-left, dock-right and close buttons.
